liebermann.description_de: Eine Sammlung dreier Stücke verschiedener Autoren
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: The Tripartita: a collection of Wl art, ECf retr and the Genealogia Normannica
liebermann.notes: A collection of three pieces by different authors — Wl art, ECf retr and the Genealogia Normannica — compiled 1140 (probably 1154)–1159, possibly by the genealogist himself. Its oldest manuscript (c. 1160) is Cb; others include Cu, Db, Kn, Lm, Oh, pehy and the appendix added to Huntingdon before 1200 in Lb, rv (Ra, Vi), Gr, Rc, La, Va, sp (S, Vl, Pl), Additional 21088, Ba, Jo, Ct, Ph; from this appendix probably also Hv and Lond (K Co Or).
